extract_rust_functions: extract standalone and class functions from tokenized Rust source code using the RustProcessor extract_functions method
get_rust_function_name: get the name of a Rust function by parsing its tokenized definition with get_function_name
detokenize_rust_code: detokenize a list of Rust tokens back into valid Rust source code using detokenize_code
extract_rust_arguments: extract function arguments from a Rust function definition using the extract_arguments method
tokenize_rust_code: tokenize Rust source code into tokens and token types using the RustProcessor dfs traversal method
